event.detail: Reviewed commit: 647f0227b7f5b6c5fe443b2d5f0c4a20de0d5513. TLDR: Considered a distinct regression-test loss from deleting the first-old-terminal startup/configuration test. The removed test checks starting a private server from generated config after adoption found nothing, its exit-empty/focus-events/hook settings and exit after the last created session. That new-server production behavior is removed at the same revision, unlike still-supported adoption of existing old servers. This is a test-responsibility assessment, not an inference that correct production code substitutes for a missing oracle. Retained an_adopted_server_ends_with_its_last_session (:9509 onward) and adoption_ends_an_empty_leftover_server (:9553 onward) exercise the existing-server lifetime rather than starting new shipped terminals. The driver's many remaining create_session calls build test fixtures; this observation is not presented as equivalent end-to-end coverage of the removed creation behavior. Suggested bucket: other (test-only concern); could-be-highest: no established security/work-loss route from this deletion.
